author: Polygon Donut
description:
Today I'll be investigating some of the most unholy colorful food items that they really were selling back then!!! Some of this stuff is truly ridiculous, I can't believe they were actually selling them lol. I also add them all to a kitchen image to create the wackiest meals imaginable...

🎨 Special thanks to these artists!
Vippori for the thumbnail render!!! https://x.com/vippori
ellielotus for character drawings https://www.instagram.com/ellielotus/
Pensilajaib09 for character emotes https://vgen.co/Pensilajaib09

📖Video Diary
I've always wanted to make a video focusing ONLY on weird foods, so I finally did it lol. But there is some overlap with other videos, where I mention a few of the same items again (such as the Shrek twinkies, and Heinz EZ Squirt). Although I made sure to always bring new info, commentary, and jokes so its not repetitive 👍

My main goal right now is to be more effecient and learn how to make videos faster for you guys. So this time I challenged myself to make
title: Cursed Snacks from the Early 2000s
